# Job Positions by Industry
<!-- id: jobs.job-positions-by-industry -->

Version: 2026-08-09

Purpose: A structured baseline of common job positions for each industry using a primary operating model plus conditional domain-role overlays.

> These are representative operating positions, not an exhaustive labor-market classification. Company size, jurisdiction, business model, union structure, licensing, and specialization can require additional or differently titled roles.

# Role Selection Standard
<!-- id: jobs.role-selection-standard -->

- Each industry receives 10 core positions from its canonical Operating Profile.
- Up to two additional domain-qualified positions are added when the Design/Halo domain requires competence missing from the primary operating model.
- Smaller organizations may combine several positions only when authority, qualification, segregation-of-duties, workload, and risk permit it.
- Larger organizations should split broad positions into specialist, manager, director, and executive roles where workload and risk justify it.
- Regulated, licensed, clinical, financial, legal, security, or safety-critical work must use appropriately qualified personnel; a title in this file does not grant authority or credentials.
- Vertical technology companies must not omit domain-qualified oversight merely because the primary Operating Profile is Software.


# Operations 2.0 Role Compilation
<!-- id: jobs.operations-2-role-compilation -->

The job titles below are representative role baselines, not complete authority specifications. When the user requests a real role description, responsibility matrix, SOP, playbook, or operating system, compile the selected role through `OPERATIONAL_PROCEDURE_COMPILER.md`.

For material roles, resolve purpose, accountabilities, scope boundaries, required inputs/outputs, systems/tools, decision ownership, approval limits, MUST/MAY/MUST NOT/STOP & ESCALATE boundaries, interfaces, evidence duties, KPI ownership, handoff responsibilities, competencies/credentials only when supplied or verified, and explicit exclusions.

Do not infer licensure, certification, system privileges, spending limits, legal authority, clinical authority, production-deployment authority, or other consequential permission from a job title.

# Agriculture & Farming
<!-- id: jobs.industry.agriculture-and-farming -->

**Operating profile:** Agriculture  
**Product profile:** Operational B2B  
**Domain/design profile:** Agriculture

## Leadership

- **General Manager** — Own overall business performance, priorities, people alignment, service quality, and operating results.

## Operations

- **Operations Manager** — Run reliable day-to-day operations, staffing, workflow, capacity, service levels, and continuous improvement.
- **Maintenance / Reliability Manager** — Maintain equipment availability, preventive maintenance, spare parts, safe repairs, and reliability improvement.

## Field Operations

- **Field Service Technician** — Perform safe, documented installation, inspection, repair, maintenance, or customer-site service within approved procedures.

## Quality

- **Quality Manager** — Define, monitor, and improve quality standards, inspections, corrective actions, and customer/product conformity.

## Supply Chain

- **Supply Chain / Procurement Manager** — Maintain reliable, cost-effective supply, inventory, vendor performance, and purchasing controls.

## Commercial

- **Sales / Business Development Manager** — Build qualified demand, manage opportunities, develop accounts, and convert suitable prospects into profitable customers.

## Finance

- **Finance / Accounting Manager** — Maintain accurate financial records, controls, cash visibility, reporting, budgeting, and financial discipline.

## Risk & Compliance

- **EHS / Safety Manager** — Manage environmental, health, and safety risks, training, inspections, incidents, and corrective actions.

## Data

- **Data / Analytics Analyst** — Produce trustworthy metrics, analysis, reporting, and decision support using governed data and reproducible methods.

<!-- id: jobs.control-plane-hooks -->

When this module is active, use `CONTROL_INDEX.md` to retrieve only the capability sections relevant to the current decision. Applicable capabilities include:

- **Role-scope integrity** — `controls/23-jobs-sops-and-operational-systems.md` (BQ-0881–BQ-0885)
- **Role-to-SOP coverage** — `controls/23-jobs-sops-and-operational-systems.md` (BQ-0901–BQ-0905)
- **Metric ownership** — `controls/23-jobs-sops-and-operational-systems.md` (BQ-0906–BQ-0910)


- **Operational Context Resolution** — `controls/31-operational-procedure-compilation-authority-and-measurement.md` (BQ-1251–BQ-1255)
- **Role & Accountability Compilation** — `controls/31-operational-procedure-compilation-authority-and-measurement.md` (BQ-1256–BQ-1260)
- **Procedure Authority Classification** — `controls/31-operational-procedure-compilation-authority-and-measurement.md` (BQ-1261–BQ-1265)
- **Executable Procedure Compilation** — `controls/31-operational-procedure-compilation-authority-and-measurement.md` (BQ-1266–BQ-1270)
- **Decision Rights & Approval Boundaries** — `controls/31-operational-procedure-compilation-authority-and-measurement.md` (BQ-1271–BQ-1275)
- **KPI Definition & Metric Governance** — `controls/31-operational-procedure-compilation-authority-and-measurement.md` (BQ-1291–BQ-1295)
